name: @pipeworx/mcp-airtable

tools.name: airtable_list_records
tools.description: Fetch records from an Airtable table with optional filtering by formula (e.g., "{Status} = 'Done'"). Returns record IDs, field values, and metadata.

maxRecords.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 100)

tools.name: airtable_get_record
tools.description: Fetch a single Airtable record by its record ID (recXXXXXXXXXXXX) from a specified base and table. Returns all field values and record metadata including created/modified timestamps.

tools.name: airtable_create_record
tools.description: Add a new record to an Airtable table with specified field values. Returns the created record ID and full record data.

fields.description: Object of field name/value pairs to set on the new record

tools.name: airtable_list_bases
tools.description: List all Airtable bases the provided personal access token can access. Returns base IDs, names, and workspace info — use to discover baseId values needed by other airtable tools.

tools.name: airtable_get_base_schema
tools.description: Get the structure of an Airtable base—all tables, field names, field types, and configurations. Use first to understand available data before querying or creating records.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-airtable forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the airtable pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
